title: Correct NotClean contract comment for committed submodule admission
outcome: The NotClean documentation matches the current Git-status predicate and its supported refusal causes.
acceptance: The NotClean comment removes the stale claim that an index-skipped tracked path is independently refused and acknowledges the documented status visibility limitation.

The comment accurately describes current refusal causes, including child filters, off-pin/uninitialized children, mapping failures and unsupported root object format, without changing runtime behavior.
